text.p: Result in the European Cup quarter-final second leg between Atletico Madrid and Ajax on Wednesday:
Atletico Madrid (Spain) 2 Ajax (Netherlands) 3 (aet. halftime 1-0, result at full-time 1-1)
Ajax: Ronald de Boer 49, Dani 98, Tijani Babangida 119

Atletico Madrid: 1-Jose Molina, 4-Roberto Solozabal, 6-Santi Denia, 9-Juan Eduardo Esnaider (7-Leonardo Biagini 96th minute), 10-Milinko Pantic, 14-Diego Simeone (5-Juan Lopez 114th), 15-Carlos Aguilera, 19-Kiko Narvaez, 20-Delfi Geli, 21-Jose Luis Caminero, 24-Radek Bejbl Ajax: 1-Edwin van der Sar, 3-Danny Blind (2-John Veldman 46th), 4-Frank de Boer, 6-Ronald de Boer, 7-Tijani Babangida, 8-Richard Witschge, 10-Jari Litmanen (21-Dani 92nd), 11-Marc Overmars, 18-Kiki Musampa (16-Nordin Wooter 88th) 19-Arnold Scholten, 29-Mario Melchiot.
